records.text: Austin Smith served one term in the Arizona House before abandoning his 2024 reelection campaign after petition-signature questions arose.
records.speaker: The Associated Press

appearances.snippet: Smith represented an Arizona House district in the Phoenix suburbs for one term before dropping his reelection bid in 2024 when questions arose about signatures on his nominating petition.

verification.notes: AP reporting confirms Smith served one Arizona House term and withdrew from the 2024 reelection race when questions arose about his nomination signatures.

records.text: An Associated Press report said the 2008 Kirkwood City Hall shooting killed two police officers and three city officials, critically injured the mayor, wounded a reporter, and ended when police killed Charles Thornton.
